theater: 洞庭湖與鼎澧潭州水寨

battle.name: 洞庭湖之戰
battle.theater: 洞庭湖與鼎澧潭州水寨
battle.brief: 紹興五年，岳飛率岳家軍自池州南下，進剿盤據洞庭湖的楊幺水軍。楊幺部造車船三十艘、海鰍船數百，依湖水漲落行「陸耕水戰」。岳飛先扼要路、斷糧道、又用降將為鄉導，五月下旬抵鼎州置寨列艦，以巨筏封港、雜草纏輪，六月內破各寨、擒斬楊幺。配重投石車此時未入中土，洞庭湖上動的是船，不是砲。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是南宋朝廷的湖廣官軍與盤據洞庭湖的楊幺割據水軍。官軍一方由岳飛在前線指揮：他以神武後軍都統制兼荊湖南路、荊湖北路、襄陽府路制置使的身分受命，總攬平定湖湘之責，但受文臣監軍節制，樞密院事兼右丞相張浚以都督諸路軍馬的身分坐鎮潭州總攬其事，荊湖南路安撫使兼潭州知州席益掌地方行政與糧餉；潭州兵馬鈐轄楊華、衡州兵馬鈐轄田明是由叛軍方面歸順後被收編的舊首領，奉命回入敵巢勸降。楊幺一方是鍾相起義的殘部與其後繼者：鍾相原為鼎州巫師，靖康之難時其長子鍾子昂曾募三百名勤王民兵北應南京應天府，父子見天下大亂，遂把民兵團集在家、結成隊伍、多置旗幟器甲；建炎四年二月，原為盜匪的京東西路東平府鈐轄孔彥舟作亂殺到澧州，鍾相乘官府逃遁之際舉事，自立為楚王，盡取洞庭湖濱諸縣。孔彥舟軍攻破其大寨，鍾相與妻伊氏、長子鍾子昂被俘處死，餘部北降偽齊；鍾子義自稱太子，楊華、楊廣充任首領，楊廣被部下所殺後，楊太被推為楊幺，稱大聖天王，以黃誠為謀士。此後曹成等陸上盜匪在紹興三年已被剿除，楊幺卻憑水軍坐大，朝廷視之為腹心之害，歷任鼎澧鎮撫使與荊南潭鼎澧岳鄂制置使皆不能制。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Huguang government forces of the Southern Song and the Yang Yao separatist water-army entrenched around Dongting Lake. On the government side the command in the field was Yue Fei. Acting as commander of the Shenwu rear army and as commissioner of the Jinghu south circuit, the Jinghu north circuit and the Xiangyang fu circuit, he was charged with putting down the revolt in the lake country; he worked under civilian overseers, and Zhang Jun, right chancellor and minister of the Privy Council, sat at Tanzhou as supervisor of all the armies in the field and kept the overall direction in his own hands. Xi Yi, pacification commissioner of Jinghu south and governor of Tanzhou, held the local administration and the supply. Yang Hua, military commissioner of Tanzhou, and Tian Ming, military commissioner of Hengzhou, were former rebel leaders who had surrendered and were now taken back into Song service, and were sent to talk their former comrades over. The Yang Yao side was the remnant of the Zhong Xiang rising and its successors. Zhong Xiang was a shaman of Dingzhou who, at the time of the Jingkang disaster, had seen his elder son Zhong Zi'ang recruit three hundred loyalist militiamen to the newly proclaimed capital at Yingtian; the father and son, seeing that the empire had fallen into disorder, turned the militia back home, massed it at the family village, drilled it into companies and equipped it with flags and armour. In the second month of 1130 Kong Yanzhou, a former bandit who held the rank of qianxia in Dongping fu of the Jingxi circuit, rose in rebellion and drove as far as Li prefecture north of Dingzhou; taking advantage of the flight of the local officials, Zhong Xiang started his rising, proclaimed himself king of Chu and seized most of the counties along the shore of Dongting Lake. Kong Yanzhou's men broke his great stockade; Zhong Xiang was taken together with his wife Lady Yi and his elder son Zhong Zi'ang and executed, and the survivors went north to surrender to the puppet Qi state. Zhong Ziyi then styled himself heir apparent, with Yang Hua and Yang Guang as leaders; Yang Guang was killed by his own men, and Yang Tai, the younger of the two, was raised as Yang Yao, who took the title of the Great Sage Heavenly King and kept Huang Cheng as his adviser. From then on the land bandits under Cao Cheng and others were destroyed in 1133, but Yang Yao grew stronger on the strength of his water force, and the court came to see him as a danger in the vitals of the state, one that had to be removed before anything else could be done; the successive pacification commissioners and circuit commissioners sent against him could not do it.
people: 核心人物是岳飛。紹興五年二月，他自池州赴平江府行在晉謁宋高宗，隨駕還臨安，受封兩鎮節度使並加荊湖南路、荊湖北路、襄陽府路制置使，進拜神武後軍都統制，得賜錢十萬貫、帛五千匹，詔曰將所部平湖賊楊幺；三月率部自池州發兵，四月上旬抵達潭州。他所領以宗澤的東京留守軍為主幹，全軍「並係西北之人，不習水戰」，他卻說「兵亦何常，惟用之如何耳」，把水戰視為可練之事。張浚是關鍵的推手，同時也是最大的懷疑者：他屢問軍計，聽到八日破賊之語便責其太易，岳飛答以「王四廂以王師攻水寇則難，飛以水寇攻水寇則易」，並解釋用敵將、敵兵，奪其手足之助、離其腹心之援，使桀黠孤立而後以王師乘之的要旨；張浚仍上奏稱「旬日之間，可見次第」，請俟六月上旬再議。幕僚黃縱主張平寇之後應耀兵振旅以震懾餘眾，岳飛遂在鼎州大閱兵。叛方人物中，楊幺自居大聖天王，謀士黃誠掌籌劃，鍾子義稱太子；黃佐、楊欽先後開寨納降，楊欽全寨三千餘名戰士連同老小萬餘人出降，並獻以雜草阻塞湖面、遏制車船之策；周倫、陳瑫、夏誠、全琮、劉詵先後或降或破。早期經手此局的還有鼎澧鎮撫使程昌㝢與荊南潭鼎澧岳鄂制置使王𤫉，皆曾大敗而無功。
peopleEn: The central figure was Yue Fei. In the second month of 1135 he travelled from Chizhou to the imperial camp at Pingjiang fu to pay court to Emperor Gaozong and returned with the emperor to Lin'an. He was made holder of two circuit commandships and appointed commissioner of the Jinghu south circuit, the Jinghu north circuit and the Xiangyang fu circuit, advanced to commander of the Shenwu rear army, and granted ten thousand guan of cash and five thousand bolts of silk, with the order to take his troops against the lake bandit Yang Yao. In the third month he marched from Chizhou and reached Tanzhou in the first ten days of the fourth month. The backbone of his force were the former Dongjing garrison troops of Zekai, and the whole army consisted, in his own words, of men from the north-west who were not used to fighting on water; he answered that arms are not fixed in their uses, only in the use made of them, and treated river fighting as something that could be drilled. Zhang Jun was the man who made the operation possible and also the man who doubted it most: he questioned Yue Fei about the plan again and again and, on hearing a promise of eight days to break the rebels, called it too easy. Yue Fei answered that Wang's four commanderies had found it hard because a royal army was attacking water bandits, whereas he would attack water bandits with water bandits, and explained the principle of taking the enemy's commanders and troops, cutting off the help of their hands and feet, cutting away the support of their heart and belly, letting the cunning one stand isolated, and then bringing the royal army down on him; even so Zhang Jun memorialized the throne that the water stockades were short of food and the ranks were thinning, that according to Yue Fei's own words some visible progress would appear within ten days, and asked to wait until the first ten days of the sixth month. His staff officer Huang Zong held that after the rebels were pacified the army should parade and show its strength to frighten the rest, and Yue Fei accordingly held a great review at Dingzhou. On the rebel side Yang Yao styled himself the Great Sage Heavenly King, with his adviser Huang Cheng in charge of plans, while Zhong Ziyi was called the heir apparent. Huang Zuo and Yang Qin opened their stockades and surrendered in turn; Yang Qin brought out more than three thousand fighting men of his whole camp, together with some ten thousand dependents, and gave the plan of blocking the surface of the lake with weeds so as to check the paddle-wheel vessels. Zhou Lun, Chen Kan, Xia Cheng, Quan Cong and Liu Shen were broken or surrendered in turn. Earlier hands on the business were Cheng Changmao, who was pacification commissioner of Dingzhou and Li prefecture, and Wang Yan, commissioner of Jingnan, Tanzhou, Dingzhou, Li prefecture, Yue prefecture and Ezhou; both were beaten and achieved nothing.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車並沒有出現在洞庭湖的水寨攻防裡面。配重式投石機是十二世紀初在歐洲地中海世界出現的新器械，靠長臂末端的配重把石彈甩過城牆，操作只需數人；它真正傳入中國要等到十三世紀，蒙古軍把中亞與波斯的工匠帶入中原之後，才以回回砲之名出現在宋金戰場上。洞庭湖之戰通篇是水戰與湖岸攻寨，配重投石車需要固定基座、穩定配重與專人操縱，既不能在淺水中行駛，也無法隨船轉向，於此毫無意義。此役真正決定勝負的是船與航具：楊幺軍造大小車船約三十艘，每艘可載千人，車船有踏板、以人工蹬踩推動，速度較快但吃水達一丈，無法在淺水中行駛；另有輕快的海鰍戰船數百艘與車船協同作戰，構成水上機動主力。官軍方面，繳自降軍的大小舟船四百餘艘是攻寨的載具，而巨筏堵塞鼎州附近各個港汊、以雜草纏住車船輪軸，才是把對方水軍釘在湖心的關鍵器材。兵器仍以刀、槍、弓弩為主，官軍另有霹靂砲、火藥箭與砲石車一類的攻城器械，但都用在岸上寨柵；攻寨還靠挖泥船、濬開河道與搭板接岸。水寨樓宇以木構為主，焚燒水寨即毀其攻守之根本。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card was not present in the fighting over the water stockades of Dongting Lake. The counterweight throwing engine was a new machine that appeared in the European Mediterranean world in the early twelfth century, hurling a stone over a wall by means of a heavy counterweight at the end of the long throwing arm and needing only a handful of men to work it. It truly reached China only in the thirteenth century, when Mongol armies brought craftsmen from Central Asia and Persia into the Chinese mainland, and it was then that it appeared on Song and Jin battlefields under the name of the Huihui pao. The whole of the Battle of Dongting Lake was water fighting and assaults on stockades from the shore; the counterweight trebuchet needed a fixed base, a steady counterweight and trained crews, it could not move in shallow water and it could not be turned with a ship, so it was of no use whatever here. What really decided the battle were the boats and the navigation. Yang Yao's men built some thirty large paddle-wheel vessels, each able to carry a thousand men; these had tread boards worked by human power, could move quickly, but drew a full chi of water and so could not travel in the shallows. Alongside them they had several hundred light and fast sea-auk war boats operating in concert, and these formed the mobile main force on the water. On the government side the several hundred large and small boats taken from the surrendered men were the carriers of the assault, while the great rafts that sealed the creeks around Dingzhou and the weeds that fouled the paddle-wheels of the enemy vessels were the crucial pieces of equipment that pinned the rebel flotilla in the middle of the lake. Arms were still sword, spear, bow and crossbow; the government army also had thunder-crash bombs, fire arrows and machines of the stone-throwing engine type for attacking stockades on land, and the assault itself used mud-dredging boats, channels dredged open by them and planks laid to make a landing. The buildings of the water stockades were mainly timber, and burning a stockade destroyed the root of its defence.
tactics: 楊幺軍用「陸耕水戰」對付官軍：春夏天漲，湖水淹田，官軍船隻難行，叛軍便在岸上耕種；秋冬水落，官軍可以出兵，叛軍則「官軍陸襲則入湖，水攻則登岸」，以游擊的方式消耗宋軍。岳飛的對策分兩手：其一，趕在春汛用兵，先分遣軍馬扼住賊的要路、斷其糧道，並嚴行禁止博易，使湖中叛軍缺食；其二，以政治誘降為主、軍事進攻為輔，施行「且招且捕之計」，把桀黠的降將用為鄉導，收回來的舊首領如田明、楊華都奉命回入敵巢勸降。黃佐投降後，岳飛單騎入其營撫問，隨即由他出面攻破周倫水寨、招降九名頭目，燒毀其寨。及至五月廿五、廿六日岳飛率師抵鼎州，置寨列艦、據水而守，以木巨筏封死各個港汊，又採楊欽之計以雜草浮塞湖面，令車船的輪軸被纏而失去機動；楊幺出戰不得，突圍又被巨筏攔截，遂全軍潰散。張浚所慮的「阻險窮絕，殆未有可投之隙」，靠的正是先斷其生計、再用其人以攻其人的辦法，而不是正面強攻。
tacticsEn: Yang Yao's troops met the government army with the method of ploughing on land and fighting on water. In spring and summer the lake rose and drowned the fields, the government boats could not move, and the rebels ploughed on the shore; in autumn and winter the water fell, the government could take the field, and the rebels then went into the lake when the government attacked by land and came ashore when the government attacked by water, wearing the Song army down by harassment. Yue Fei's answer had two parts. First, he fought in the spring flood season, detaching troops in advance to hold the rebels' vital roads, cutting their supply line and strictly forbidding trade, so that those in the lake went short of food. Second, he made political inducement the main instrument and military pressure the auxiliary, carrying out what he called a plan of catching and recruiting at one and the same time, and turning the cunning men who surrendered into guides; old leaders who had come back, such as Tian Ming and Yang Hua, were ordered to return into the enemy camp and work for the surrender of their former comrades. After Huang Zuo surrendered, Yue Fei rode alone into his camp to welcome him, and Huang Zuo then took the assault on Zhou Lun's water stockade, brought in nine leaders and burned the camp. When on the twenty-fifth and twenty-sixth days of the fifth month Yue Fei brought his army to Dingzhou, he set up his camp, ranged his ships and held the water; he sealed the creeks with great timber rafts and, on Yang Qin's advice, floated weeds across the lake surface so that the paddle-wheels of the enemy vessels were fouled and lost their mobility. Yang Yao could not bring his ships into action, his attempt to break out was intercepted again by the rafts, and the force dissolved. What Zhang Jun had feared, that the enemy held ground which was perilous and exhausted, leaving no opening to be attacked, was met not by a frontal assault but by cutting the enemy's livelihood first and then using the enemy's own men against him.
data: 此役的數字大致可考。楊幺軍作戰兵力約五、六萬，加上家眷有數十萬之眾；所控制的縣份計有十九個，包括鼎州全境四縣、澧州全境四縣、荊南府八縣中的四縣、峽州宜都、岳州華容、辰州沅陵，以及潭州十二縣中的四縣。車船約三十艘，每艘可載千人，吃水一丈；海鰍戰船數百艘。楊欽一寨出降者，戰士三千多人連同老小共一萬多人，繳獲大小舟船四百餘艘、牛五百多頭、馬四十多匹。時間線清楚：紹興五年三月岳家軍自池州出發，四月上旬抵潭州，四月十四日黃佐部攻破周倫水寨，五月廿五、廿六日岳飛至鼎州前線，六月二日楊欽出降，自抵鼎州至夏誠最後一寨陷落約十四五日，鍾子義被押至潭州又遲四、五日，合計略越岳飛自定的八日之限。善後方面，岳飛將二萬七千多戶老弱出給公據、支米糧歸業，數萬名壯丁編入宋軍，另有周倫等部別編橫江水軍不歸岳家軍，餘者遣送鎮江府令其力農。朝廷所賜岳飛為錢十萬貫、帛五千匹。
dataEn: The figures for this campaign can be roughly established. Yang Yao's field forces numbered about fifty to sixty thousand men, and with their dependents they counted tens of thousands of households; they held nineteen counties in all, namely the four counties of Dingzhou prefecture, the four counties of Li prefecture, four of the eight counties of Jingnan fu, Yidu in Xia prefecture, Huarong in Yue prefecture, Yuanling in Chen prefecture, and four of the twelve counties of Tanzhou prefecture. There were some thirty paddle-wheel vessels, each able to carry a thousand men and drawing a full chi of water, and several hundred light sea-auk war boats. From Yang Qin's camp alone more than three thousand fighting men and some ten thousand dependents came out to surrender, and the government took several hundred large and small boats, more than five hundred head of oxen and more than forty horses. The chronology is firm: in the third month of 1135 the Yue army left Chizhou; in the first ten days of the fourth month it reached Tanzhou; on the fourteenth day of the fourth month Huang Zuo's men broke Zhou Lun's water stockade; on the twenty-fifth and twenty-sixth days of the fifth month Yue Fei himself reached the front at Dingzhou; on the second day of the sixth month Yang Qin surrendered; from the arrival at Dingzhou to the fall of the last stockade, that of Xia Cheng, was about fourteen or fifteen days, and the bringing of Zhong Ziyi to Tanzhou took another four or five days, so that the total slightly exceeded the eight days Yue Fei had set himself. In the settlement, Yue Fei gave public documents to more than twenty-seven thousand households of old and weak, issued grain and returned them to their fields, drew several tens of thousands of able-bodied men into the Song army, formed the men of Zhou Lun and others into a separate Hengjiang river force not belonging to the Yue army, and sent those with nowhere to go to Zhenjiang fu to work the abandoned fields. What the court granted Yue Fei was ten thousand guan of cash and five thousand bolts of silk.
cause: 起事根源在鍾氏父子的另立一法之志與亂世的不平。鍾相是鼎州巫師，宋徽宗時已有「法分貴賤貧富，非善法也，我行法，當等貴賤，均貧富」的想法，意欲仿李順、王小波那樣另立一法；靖康之難後，他與長子鍾子昂把遣回鄉里的三百名勤王民兵團集在家、結成隊伍、多置旗幟器甲，意在作亂。建炎四年二月，京東西路東平府鈐轄孔彥舟作亂，殺到澧州北面，地方官逃遁，鍾相乘機舉事，自立為楚王，旬月之間取洞庭湖濱大部分州縣，所過州郡不能制。孔彥舟軍攻破其大寨，鍾相父子被處死，餘眾北投偽齊；鍾子義、楊華等收拾餘眾轉入辰陽，楊太被推為楊幺後勢力更大，靠數十艘車船與數百艘海鰍船控制湖面，宋廷屢派鎮撫使、制置使討之而無功，終至視之為「腹心之害，不先去之，無以立國」。紹興四年八月朝廷本已調剛克復襄漢的岳家軍南下，卻因淮南西路須留軍對抗金、偽齊聯軍而拖延半年；待紹興五年再議用兵時，湖中割據已坐大五年。
causeEn: The roots of the rising lay in the Zhong family's resolve to set up another law, and in the disorder of the times. Zhong Xiang was a shaman of Dingzhou who, as early as the reign of Emperor Huizong, had held that a law which divides the noble from the base and the rich from the poor is not a good law, that if he followed his own law he would equalize rank and wealth; he wanted to do as Li Shun and Wang Xiaobo had done and set up a law of his own. After the Jingkang disaster he and his elder son Zhong Zi'ang took the three hundred loyalist militiamen who had been sent home, massed them at the family village, drilled them into companies and equipped them with flags and armour, meaning to rise. In the second month of 1130 Kong Yanzhou, holding the rank of qianxia in Dongping fu of the Jingxi circuit, rose in rebellion and drove as far as Li prefecture north of Dingzhou; the local officials fled, and Zhong Xiang took the chance to start his rising, proclaimed himself king of Chu, and within a few weeks took most of the counties along Dongting Lake, no prefecture or county being able to hold him. Kong Yanzhou's men broke his great stockade, Zhong Xiang and his son were killed, and the survivors went north to the puppet Qi state. Zhong Ziyi, Yang Hua and the rest gathered what was left and moved into Chen yang; Yang Tai, raised as Yang Yao, built the force larger still, holding the lake with some dozens of paddle-wheel vessels and several hundred sea-auk boats. The Song court sent pacification commissioners and circuit commissioners against him one after another and achieved nothing, until it came to see him as a danger in the vitals of the state, one that had to be removed before the state could be established. In the eighth month of 1134 the court had already ordered the newly victorious Yue army south, but the need to keep troops in the west of Huainan against the allied forces of Jin and the puppet Qi delayed the operation by half a year; by the time it was debated again in 1135, the separatist power on the lake had already grown for five years.
impact: 此役對南宋的第一層意義，是把後方清出來。岳家軍平定楊幺之後，洞庭湖一帶再未出現同類規模的叛亂，岳飛的後方從此安定，可以專心北向對付金軍與偽齊之兵。對大批降眾的編置則改變了湖湘的軍事格局：數萬壯丁編入宋軍，周倫等部另編橫江水軍而不歸岳家軍序列，等於湖湘水軍第一次有了獨立的建制；二萬七千餘戶老弱出給公據、支糧歸業，無所歸著者遣送鎮江府以逃荒之田令其力農，則是把一支水上武裝拆散為耕作者業。宋廷自此把招撫視為平叛的常法，岳飛以減敵之將、用地盤之兵、離敵之腹心，再用王師乘之的「以水寇攻水寇」辦法，也成為後世平叛的成法。張浚「岳侯殆神算」之歎，與席益屢次主張彈劾岳飛玩寇的記載，則留下另一面：主撫與主戰之間在中樞並無共識，同一支軍隊在北方對金人時被指怯戰退師，在南方對叛軍時卻連克州郡，這種反差成為後世議論岳飛的常用題材。技術上，楊幺車船吃水一丈、以踏板人力蹬踩的造法與海鰍船的配合，後來為南宋水軍沿用，成為長江防務的一項底子。
impactEn: The first layer of meaning of this campaign is that the rear was cleared. After the Yue army had pacified Yang Yao, no rising of comparable size appeared again around Dongting Lake; the rear of Yue Fei's army was settled from then on, and he could devote himself to the Jin forces and the troops of the puppet Qi in the north. The settlement and registration of the large body of surrendered men changed the military geography of the lake country: several tens of thousands of able-bodied men were drawn into the Song army, and the men of Zhou Lun and others were formed into a separate Hengjiang river force that did not belong to the Yue army, which meant that the lake and river forces of Huguang had an independent establishment for the first time; and more than twenty-seven thousand households of old and weak were given public documents and grain to return to their fields, while those with nowhere to go were sent to Zhenjiang fu to work the abandoned land, which meant taking a force that had lived on the water apart and turning it into a body of cultivators. From then on the court treated inducement as the standing method of putting down rebellions, and Yue Fei's device of taking away the enemy's commanders, using the enemy's ground and men, cutting off the enemy's heart and belly, and then bringing the royal army down on the remainder came to be a standard recipe for later suppression of revolts. Zhang Jun's sigh that the Marquis of Yue had seemed a master of calculation, together with the records of Xi Yi pressing again and again to impeach Yue Fei for playing with the enemy, preserve the other side of the matter: there was no agreement at court between those who favoured conciliation and those who favoured war. The same army that was accused of running away from the Jin in the north won county after county in the south against rebels, and that contrast became a stock theme in later discussion of Yue Fei. In technical terms, the paddle-wheel vessel drawing a full chi of water, worked by human tread, and the cooperation of the sea-auk boats were afterwards taken over by the Southern Song navy and became one of the foundations of river defence on the Yangtze.
result: 結果是一場在十幾日內結束的平叛。六月二日楊欽率全寨出降，岳飛親至鼎州城東視察受降，申報張浚授楊欽武義大夫，並把宋高宗所賜的金束帶與戰袍轉贈，設筵相待；楊欽又勸降了全琮、劉詵等部。巨筏封港與雜草纏輪之後，楊幺出戰不得，突圍不成，楊幺軍統制陳瑫以鍾子義的座船投降官軍，楊幺被俘後即被斬首；鍾子義泅水回到水寨，也被已決心投降的黃誠、周倫抓住，押解至潭州張浚的都督行府。餘下各個水寨接連被擊破或招安，最後只剩楊幺軍禁軍三衙步軍司統帥夏誠的一個水寨，因逼近被毀而不得不降。岳飛將二萬七千餘戶老弱出給公據、支米糧歸業，數萬壯丁編入宋軍，殘餘無所歸著者遣送鎮江府令其力農。事後岳家軍北撤鄂州一帶防秋，岳飛在鼎州一帶大閱兵，軍律嚴整、旗幟精明，觀者無不咨嗟嘆息，張浚歎服，謂岳侯殆神算。
resultEn: The outcome was a pacification finished within a little over a fortnight. On the second day of the sixth month Yang Qin came out with his whole camp and surrendered; Yue Fei came in person to the east of Dingzhou city to inspect the surrender, memorialized to Zhang Jun for Yang Qin to be granted the rank of wuyi dafu, handed on the gold belt and battle robe that the emperor had bestowed, and had a feast prepared for him. Yang Qin in turn persuaded Quan Cong, Liu Shen and their men to surrender. Once the great rafts had sealed the creeks and the weeds had fouled the paddle-wheels, Yang Yao could not bring his ships into action and could not break out; Chen Kan, a commander of Yang Yao's army, surrendered to the government with the flagship of Zhong Ziyi, and Yang Yao was beheaded as soon as he was taken. Zhong Ziyi swam back to his stockade and was seized there by Huang Cheng and Zhou Lun, who had already decided to surrender, and taken under escort to the supervisor's headquarters of Zhang Jun at Tanzhou. The remaining water stockades were broken or surrendered one after another, and only the single stockade of Xia Cheng, commander of the infantry of the imperial guard within Yang Yao's army, was left, and it surrendered because it was on the point of being destroyed. Yue Fei gave public documents and grain to more than twenty-seven thousand households of old and weak, drew several tens of thousands of able-bodied men into the Song army, and sent those with nowhere to go to Zhenjiang fu to work the land. Afterwards the Yue army withdrew north to the Ezhou area to prepare for the autumn offensive, and Yue Fei held a great review in the neighbourhood of Dingzhou, where the discipline of the army was strict and the banners were smart, and all who watched sighed in admiration; Zhang Jun was convinced and said that the Marquis of Yue had seemed a master of calculation.
